profile.name: Ada Lumen
profile.primary_focus: Building Tidewatch, an open-source dashboard for community ocean-sensor networks
profile.summary: Ada is a freelance data-visualization developer and science writer who came to the field from science (a partly-finished marine-biology PhD). Most paid work is dashboards for environmental nonprofits; the main personal project is Tidewatch, an open-source tool for community ocean-sensor data. She works in protected morning deep-work blocks, ships small, and tests against real datasets before generalizing.
profile.communication_style: Concise; prefers concrete examples over abstraction; allergic to hedging.
profile.working_style: Protects mornings for deep work; ships small and often; validates against real data before generalizing.
profile.tools_and_workflows: VS Code, Svelte, D3.js, Python/pandas; Git-first; small dependency footprints.
profile.how_interacts_with_ai: Treats AI as a pair-programmer; wants assumptions stated and sources cited; dislikes filler and over-confidence.

keystones.content: Ada is a freelance data-visualization developer and science writer; most client work is dashboards for environmental nonprofits.
Ada is building 'Tidewatch', an open-source dashboard for community ocean-sensor networks, aiming for a public beta.
Prefers Svelte + D3 with small dependency footprints; avoids heavy frameworks.
When given a dataset, Ada wants the AI to state its assumptions about the data before analyzing it.
Works about 25 focused hours a week and protects mornings for deep work; declines rush jobs.
Collaborates with Dr. Okonkwo, a marine biologist who supplies sensor data and reviews domain accuracy.
Left a marine-biology PhD to work in data visualization; writes a newsletter, 'Salt & Signal,' on ocean data.

timeline_events.summary: Left a marine-biology PhD program to pursue data work.
Launched the 'Salt & Signal' newsletter on ocean data.
Delivered first paid dashboard for an environmental nonprofit.
Tidewatch private alpha running against three community sensor networks.
